title: Glazed Carrots & Parsnips With Sorghum
description: Blackberry Farm puts regional ingredients at the center of this simple side of sorghum-glazed carrots and parsnips. Made by pressing sweet sorghum stalks and boiling down their juice, the dark, flavorful syrup has deep roots in Southern and Appalachian cooking and remains closely associated with the region.
ingredients: 2 pounds medium carrots, peeled and trimmed
2 pounds medium parsnips, peeled and trimmed
6 garlic cloves, smashed using side of a knife
1 to 2 teaspoons chopped fresh thyme, as desired
directions: If parsnips and carrots are small to medium in size, leave whole. If larger, cut in half lengthwise or quarter, trying to maintain uniformity of size so they will cook evenly.
Toss carrots, parsnips, and garlic with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a large rimmed baking sheet; spread in an even layer.
Roast until vegetables are tender, 40 to 50 minutes.
Transfer to a bowl; drizzle with syrup, and top with walnuts and thyme. Serve warm.
